correctness.rationale: Explicit 12-vertex, 24-edge graph; exhaustive augmented face census 2649; exact integral acyclic algebraic Morse matching 1296 unit pairs with 57 critical faces of cardinality four; 9960-arrow directed Hasse graph topologically sorted. Therefore reduced integral H3 = Z^57 and zero otherwise. Independently evaluated fixed-oriented-simplex and orbit-compressed Lefschetz traces agree elementwise for all 48 cube symmetries. Exact S4 character inner products reproduce all ten class values and multiplicities, with central eigenspaces 34 and 23 and one full-group invariant. The included standalone checker was run successfully.

value.rationale: Complete natural 48-element action of a canonical nonouterplanar cuboctahedral matching complex, refining an established nonequivariant sphere-wedge result. Both the (34,23) central eigenspace split and the unique globally invariant rational class are structural symmetry invariants not fixed by Betti numbers. The ten-class character and ten irreducible multiplicities address a motivated precise gap for a highly symmetric finite complex, with no arbitrary choice of graph slice or unsupported infinite-family claim.
